description: Domain ontology and architectural knowledge graph mapping IronForge 2.0 AI fitness systems, Expo Router 4-tab architecture, services, and Supabase database schema.

nodes.label: TabLayout
nodes.description: Expo Router 4-tab bar layout (Command Deck, Smart Pantry, Hypertrophy Forge, Macro Console) with 64px height, Liquid Obsidian & Blood Ember styling, and tactile active tints.

nodes.label: CommandDeckScreen
nodes.description: Central Command Deck displaying real-time system pulse, Hero training card with Launch Session, daily macro status bar, quick visual portals, and Open-Meteo weather telemetry.

nodes.label: SmartPantryScreen
nodes.description: Smart Pantry Vision screen with camera/gallery picker, expo-image-manipulator compression, Gemini 3.8 Flash analysis, detected ingredient tags, 3 gym-focused recipes, and Log to Diet syncing.

nodes.label: HypertrophyForgeScreen
nodes.description: Hypertrophy Forge screen with split selection pills (Push, Pull, Legs, Upper, Lower), equipment toggles, Free Exercise DB generator, 16:9 thumbnail previews, RPE, and haptic set completion checkboxes.

nodes.label: MacroConsoleScreen
nodes.description: Macro Fuel Console with circular calorie progress ring, Protein/Carbs/Fats horizontal progress bars, today's logged meals timeline synced from pantry, and quick-add modal.

nodes.label: navigationService
nodes.description: Universal navigation bus and subscriber bridge linking interactive buttons and Command Deck portals directly to active tabs with tactile haptic dispatch.

nodes.label: dietService
nodes.description: Calculates daily energy budgets and protein quotas, manages local & Supabase meal persistence, and searches Open Food Facts.

nodes.label: fridgeVision
nodes.description: Multimodal computer vision pipeline analyzing food images via Gemini Flash and enriching nutritional data using the Open Food Facts public API.

nodes.label: exerciseCatalog
nodes.description: Normalized Free Exercise DB catalog containing 876 exercises mapped with compound/isolation mechanics, equipment filters, and anatomical instructions.

nodes.label: workoutCatalog
nodes.description: Pre-compiled hypertrophy training directory providing battle-tested training programs (PPL, Upper/Lower, Arnold) with zero network delay and direct looping demonstrations.

nodes.label: workoutGenerator
nodes.description: Dynamic hypertrophy generation engine integrating Free Exercise DB catalog and algorithmic routine assembly prioritized by user training split and equipment.

nodes.label: exerciseMediaService
nodes.description: Provides silent, looping biomechanical demonstration GIFs, videos, and 16:9 poster preview thumbnails mapped from verified ExerciseDB & Free Exercise DB open CDN assets.

nodes.label: videoCacheService
nodes.description: Manages local device caching, background pre-fetching, and instant offline ready status for exercise looping video demonstrations using expo-file-system.

nodes.label: weatherService
nodes.description: Public weather service consuming Open-Meteo Weather API and Geocoding API to provide real-time temperature, humidity, UV index, athletic training advisories, and hydration targets.

nodes.label: WeatherCard
nodes.description: High-end glass telemetry card displaying current climate conditions, Celsius/Fahrenheit toggle, athlete training advisories, 6-hour forecast, and global city search modal.

nodes.label: Profile (User)
nodes.description: Primary athlete profile linked 1-to-1 with Supabase auth.users.

nodes.label: WorkoutRoutine
nodes.description: Hypertrophy training splits and periodized exercise schedules generated from Free Exercise DB.

nodes.label: FridgeIngredient
nodes.description: Raw food items and nutritional supplies parsed by computer vision or entered manually.

nodes.label: SmartRecipes
nodes.description: AI-synthesized high-protein culinary recipes matching detected ingredients to macro goals.

edges.description: TabLayout mounts Command Deck as the primary root index tab.
TabLayout mounts Smart Pantry Vision as the secondary pantry tab.
TabLayout mounts Hypertrophy Forge as the tertiary workout tab.
TabLayout mounts Macro Console as the quaternary diet tab.
Command Deck hero buttons and visual portal cards trigger tab navigation transitions.
Command Deck queries today's caloric and protein targets to render the daily macro fuel bar.
Command Deck embeds the WeatherCard for real-time training climate telemetry and Open-Meteo forecasts.
WeatherCard calls Open-Meteo public API via weatherService for weather telemetry and geocoding.
Smart Pantry Vision invokes analyzeFridgeContents with compressed image URI.
fridgeVision extracts detected food ingredients from refrigerator photos.
fridgeVision synthesizes 3 gym-tailored high-protein recipes strictly based on detected ingredients.
Smart Pantry recipes are logged directly to the shared daily nutrition log via addMealToDailyLog.
Hypertrophy Forge invokes generateTargetedWorkout with user split, equipment, and duration.
Hypertrophy Forge instantly loads pre-compiled programs and exercises from workoutCatalog with zero network delay.
workoutGenerator filters the 876-exercise Free Exercise DB catalog locally by split and equipment.
Hypertrophy Forge persists generated routines and set completion checklist into Supabase workout_routines.
Macro Console queries daily targets, consumes logged meals timeline, and adds quick meals.
dietService persists meal records and macro progress to Supabase diet_logs.
A user profile maintains daily nutrition and macronutrient logs across time.
workoutGenerator resolves looping biomechanical demonstration GIFs, videos, and poster thumbnails for every routine exercise.
Hypertrophy Forge renders silent, auto-looping exercise technique demonstrations with biomechanical form checklists.
Hypertrophy Forge resolves local cached video URIs and triggers offline split downloads for gym use via expo-file-system.
A user configures and manages multiple active/historical workout routines.
